name: ai-use-policy-generator
display_name: AI Use Policy Generator for Law Firms
description: One skill: /ai-use-policy. A short guided interview produces three ready-to-adopt documents: an internal AI-use policy, a client-facing AI-disclosure clause for engagement letters, and a one-page safe AI checklist. Flags consumer-grade tools that are touching client data and suggests safer alternatives. All output is a starting draft requiring attorney review and formal firm adoption.
